chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Tatarri said: Abd Allah ibn Waddah narrated to me from Sama'ah ibn Mihran, who said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me:
"Beware of praying before the sun moves (from its zenith), for indeed you are praying in the time of Asr; it is better for you to pray before the sun moves."

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (title of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq)
key_terms.تَزُولَ: moves (referring to the sun moving from its zenith)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on praying before the sun moves from its zenith according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Sahih al-Tusi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the boundary between Dhuhr and Asr, warning that praying before the sun's zenith (Qubz) risks performing Dhuhr in the time of Asr, which is less virtuous. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on 'early performance' (Taqdim) of obligatory prayers, ensuring they are offered at the beginning of their designated time windows rather than delaying them into the subsequent period.
